fields.name: compress
fields.description: Compresses the payload in GZIP format. Datadog supports and recommends setting this to gzip.

fields.name: dd_hostname
fields.description: The host the emitted logs should be associated with. If unset, Datadog expects the host to be set with host, hostname, or syslog.hostname attributes. See Datadog Logs preprocessor documentation for recognized attributes.

fields.name: dd_message_key
fields.description: By default, the plugin searches for the key log and remaps the value to the key message. If the property is set, the plugin searches for the property name key.

fields.name: dd_service
fields.description: Recommended. The human readable name for your service generating the logs. For example, the name of your application or database. If not set, Datadog looks for the service using service remapper.

fields.name: dd_source
fields.description: Recommended. A human-readable name for the underlying technology of your service like postgres or nginx. If unset, Datadog looks for the source in the ddsource attribute.

fields.name: dd_tags
fields.description: The tags you want to assign to your logs in Datadog. If unset, Datadog looks for the tags in the ddtags attribute.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Add additional arbitrary HTTP header key/value pair. Multiple headers can be set.

fields.name: host
fields.description: The Datadog server where you are sending your logs.

fields.name: include_tag_key
fields.description: If enabled, a tag is appended to the output. The key name is used with the tag_key property.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: To activate remapping, specify the configuration flag provider with the value ecs.

fields.name: proxy
fields.description: Specifies an HTTP proxy. The expected format of this value is http://host:port. HTTPS isn't supported.

fields.name: tag_key
fields.description: The key name of tag. If include_tag_key is false, this property is ignored.

fields.name: tls
fields.description: End-to-end security communications protocol. Datadog recommends setting this to on.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
